records.title: Stitch & Scale
records.text: Skip setup Welcome to Stitch & Scale Professional knitwear grading software — built for designers who care about the details. Local-first — your projects save instantly, no account needed Works offline — full functionality without an internet connection Your data belongs to you — export anytime, no lock-in Publish-ready PDF exports — four professional templates Cloud Sync is optional. You never need an account to start designing. Back Begin Local Storage Notice Your patterns are saved right here on this device — no account needed. Clearing your browser data will delete them, so back up anything you can't afford to lose. Cloud sync is on the way, which will make this less of a worry. A blank canvas awaits Set your gauge, add your measurements, and let Stitch & Scale handle the grading math. Built for designers who care about the details. Draft a New Pattern Import from a Spreadsheet or restore a backup from a .json file A premium tool for independent knitwear designers

records.title: Stitch & Scale
records.text: Stitch & Scale Open demo Try it free For indie knitwear pattern designers You can knit anything. Can you price it? The pattern is only half the job — the math is the rest. Grading, yield, pricing, wholesale, international parity: the business side of knitting that nobody built tools for. So I built them. Run your pattern business on numbers, not hope. Try the live demo Join as a founding tester No signup. No install. The demo is the real app with a sample project. 79 business labs in one workspace 1,694+ verified tests behind the math 13 currencies in parity pricing 100% local-first — your data stays yours One workspace for the whole pattern business Marketplaces take 15–20% and own your customer. The tools below are built so you can price, publish, and sell on your own terms. Grading Lab Multi-size grading tables from one set of measurements. Enter a size, get the range — checked against your grading rules, every row. Yield & Cost Yarn estimates, wastage, and true unit cost per size.
